title: RELIABILITY INC 8-K Filing — 2026-04-10
summary: Reliability Incorporated (RLBY), an OTC-traded micro-cap company, filed an 8-K disclosing the completion of a share transfer pursuant to a settlement agreement with Vivos Holdings. Approximately 253.3 million shares were returned to the company, reducing outstanding shares to 46.7 million as of April 2, 2026. The company also amended its bylaws and plans to call a shareholder meeting later in 2026.
key_points: Consent judgment entered April 2, 2026, transferring 253,292,210 shares from Vivos Parties back to the company
Company's outstanding shares reduced from approximately 300 million to 46,707,790 shares
Transfer completed by Equiniti Shareholder Services on April 2, 2026
Bylaws amended and restated effective April 10, 2026 (Section 1.1 address change only)
Company plans to hold a shareholder meeting later in 2026
Stockholders should note potential filing obligations due to changed ownership percentages
